scripts.deps:up: docker compose up -d postgres ollama && docker compose run --rm ollama-init
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:py: concurrently -k -n api-py,web -c yellow,green "npm run dev:api:py" "API_URL=http://localhost:8000 npm run dev:web"
scripts.start:local: npm run deps:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w api" "npm run start -w web"
